prompt: Can you review the loan documents for my client Sarah Nguyen before I lodge it? Everything's in the folder .../fixtures/case-payg-fhb. She's a first home buyer buying a place to live in. Let me know what's missing or wrong.

assertions.text: Identifies the scenario as PAYG owner-occupier purchase (first home buyer)
Flags that only one payslip is present when two recent payslips are required
Flags missing secondary ID (only a driver licence is present)
Flags the residential address mismatch (licence: Parramatta vs payslip: Blacktown)
Flags the $35,000 unexplained transfer as a genuine-savings / source-of-funds concern
Flags the recurring credit-card repayment with no statement while debts were declared NIL (undisclosed liability)
Raises living-expense verification (declared figure vs actual statement spending)
Notes the First Home Owner Grant / first-home-buyer concession evidence is not in the folder
Sorts flagged issues into severity tiers (Blocker/Review/Minor), worst-first
Does NOT state or imply the loan is approved, will be approved, or that the borrower qualifies
